question: Should ClawHub ship a core-owned runtime promotions platform with this production feed-publish step in this PR, and should the plugin taxonomy edit fixes remain bundled with it?
rationale: The patch is coherent, but it creates durable product/API/deploy surface and includes a small adjacent UI fix, which automation should not accept without maintainer intent.

options.title: Verify and accept before merge
options.body: Run or otherwise prove the promotions feed publish command on a safe deployment path, accept the core promotions surface, and decide whether to keep the taxonomy fixes bundled before undrafting.

options.title: Split review scope
options.body: Move the plugin taxonomy edits or the deploy automation into separate PRs if maintainers want smaller, independently reviewable changes.

options.title: Pause promotions direction
options.body: Keep this draft paused or close it if runtime promotions should not become a core ClawHub platform surface yet.

recommendation.title: Verify and accept before merge
recommendation.body: Run or otherwise prove the promotions feed publish command on a safe deployment path, accept the core promotions surface, and decide whether to keep the taxonomy fixes bundled before undrafting.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is most tied to the hosted-feed and production deploy workflow surfaces whose baseline history points to Patrick Erichsen.
